$comment: (T940, owner 2026-11-20: 'Satellite should maybe just be its own colors? Best for satellite?') THE WATER OVER SATELLITE IMAGERY: one value for each water token, used in place of the theme's while the ground is satellite, the SAME in light, dark and colour-blind. The photograph does not change with the theme, so neither does what is drawn on it. Applied to the water layers only (layer group `water` and the stream's and lake's marks: src/on-imagery.ts `onImageryTokens`, the adapter's paint) and to the map key while satellite is drawn (`groundTheme`); land, labels and the drawn map keep the theme's values. A value may name another token ('@color.status.own'): one in this set, or one already the same in every theme. Chosen for photographs: every line status is at least 3:1 on dark forest, shadow and water, and the statuses are held apart over imagery for every reader (tools/status-colours-distinct.test.ts, the satellite rows). `pnpm style:build` checks this set against each theme's other map colours as they appear over satellite.
